lines.en: Hollis Ford. Forty-one people. One well.
Six people. Same morning. Same water.
lines.name: NELL

lines.en: Sick ones stay in the barn. Nobody opens it.
lines.name: MAYOR

lines.en: A bite hits one. Bad water hits everyone.
There was a dead rat. I tried to get it out.
lines.name: TIMO

lines.en: Someone opened this well last night.
lines.name: NELL
